notes: v3.0.40 - Pull days with schedule-keyword surnames now import completely even when athenaOne welds the name into the duration or age text (the exact rendering that made a Friday refuse over and over). An empty day must now prove it settled before it is recorded as verified-empty, so a day read mid-transition can never be stored as having no patients. After an extension update, open MLS and athenaOne tabs heal themselves: stale copies of the bridge go silent instead of racing the fresh one with failures, and the panel pull button keeps working. A day only counts as complete when every imported row traces to a real row on the grid - a text-scrape phantom can no longer stand in for a dropped patient. Note-write verification is stricter: a write that changed nothing, a truncated landing, or foreign text can no longer be reported as verified, multi-paragraph notes into rich-text editors keep their line breaks (and roll back cleanly if unverified), and free-typing into athenaOne outside the reviewed flow is disabled. Chart history reads wait for athena to finish painting before capturing (no more half-painted problem lists), and very large charts up to 160k characters can now complete. Requires Chrome 116+.
